facebook.caption: This place fixes a bad beach day. Mojito Beach Bar on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo hits different when the sun drops. Cold drinks, sand underfoot, zero pretension. Budget sits at $15-30 per person, which for a beach bar with this vibe is genuinely fair. 4.4 stars across 86 reviews backs that up. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
